lines.en: My feet never touch the ground; I drift

lines.zh: 粉色团子一样的身子一颠一颠
lines.en: My pink puffball body bobs along
Little feet step on nothing but air
One sway and I'm above your head
My belly arrives before the rest of me

lines.zh: 手臂松松地晃着，像面条
lines.en: My arms dangle loose as noodles

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，从这块石头到那块
lines.en: I bounce from this rock to that one

lines.zh: 蒸汽从我身上的洞里钻出来
lines.en: Steam hisses from the holes in me
I drift a little circle around you

lines.zh: 地面被我压出浅浅的印子
lines.en: I press shallow marks into the ground

lines.zh: 我飘到树梢那么高，又落下来
lines.en: I float to treetop height and settle

lines.zh: 我摸着自己圆圆的肚子
lines.en: I pat my round belly

lines.zh: 我打了个大哈欠，牙都露出来
lines.en: I yawn wide, showing all my teeth

lines.zh: 洞里冒出的蒸汽越来越细
lines.en: The steam from my vents thins out

lines.zh: 我盯着半空，什么也没看
lines.en: I stare at nothing in the air

lines.zh: 我抠了抠脑袋上的触须
lines.en: I pick at the feeler on my head
I laugh, and it sounds utterly innocent

lines.zh: 我把脑袋歪到不该歪的角度
lines.en: I tip my head at an impossible angle
I snort and steam puffs from my nose
I count on my fingers, one by one

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴唇，想到甜的
lines.en: I lick my lips, thinking of sweets

lines.zh: 这地方太空了，没什么可玩的
lines.en: This place is empty; nothing to play with

lines.zh: 我把身子鼓起来又瘪下去
lines.en: I puff myself up and let it out
I sit cross-legged on nothing
I sway and hum to myself

lines.zh: 我低下头看你，离得很近
lines.en: I lean down close to look at you

lines.zh: 你的气很小，可我能闻到
lines.en: Your ki is tiny, but I can smell it

lines.zh: 我伸出一根手指，点了点空气
lines.en: I poke the air with one finger

lines.zh: 你要陪我玩吗？就一会儿
lines.en: Will you play with me? Just a little

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，眼睛几乎没了
lines.en: When I smile my eyes nearly vanish
I'm not angry; truly not angry

lines.zh: 你的心跳变快了，我听见了
lines.en: Your heart sped up; I heard it

lines.zh: 我把脸凑到你面前，挤得变形
lines.en: I push my face close until it squashes

lines.zh: 我数你身上的东西，一二三
lines.en: I count the things you carry, one, two, three

lines.zh: 你手里的武器看起来会疼
lines.en: That weapon looks like it would hurt
I tilt my head and my feeler droops
I slap my belly and it booms
Let's play hide and seek
I'll close my eyes first; don't run
I put my hands behind my back, all innocent

lines.zh: 我笑得太久了，你开始退
lines.en: I've smiled too long; you start backing up
If you're scared, I'll hold still

lines.zh: 我闻到你的气了，很好闻
lines.en: I smell your ki; it's pleasant
I yelp and pull my belly in

lines.zh: 被打的地方凹下去一块
lines.en: The struck spot dents inward

lines.zh: 我不笑了，一点都不好笑
lines.en: I've stopped laughing; none of it's funny
I float up and settle back
Steam bursts harder from my vents
I rub the spot that was hit
A seam opens on me and closes again
My eyes narrow to a slit
I drift back a few steps, my ki thinning
I'll keep this punch in mind

lines.zh: 那是糖吗？我一直想吃糖
lines.en: Is that candy? I've wanted candy forever
Something sweet! I'm melting already

lines.zh: 你把糖举高，我就踮起脚
lines.en: You hold it high and I go on tiptoe
I open my mouth and wait for the toss

lines.zh: 我一口吞了，连你的手一起
lines.en: I swallow it, and nearly your hand
One more piece, just one
I don't eat people; I eat candy
My feeler stands straight up

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起很久以前
lines.en: This taste reminds me of long ago
Are you hiding more? I can smell it

lines.zh: 你撞在我肚子上，被弹开了
lines.en: You bounce right off my belly

lines.zh: 我软软的，可你也撞不进去
lines.en: I'm soft, but you can't push through
My arm brushes your shoulder
We bounce off each other
You slide down off me

lines.zh: 我被撞得晃了晃，还在笑
lines.en: The bump rocks me, and I'm still laughing

lines.zh: 你一脚踩在我的脚背上
lines.en: You stepped square on my foot

lines.zh: 我的身体陷下去一块，又鼓回来
lines.en: My body dents and swells back

lines.zh: 我们挤在一处，我占了太多地方
lines.en: We crowd together; I take up too much room
I reach out and set you upright

lines.zh: 另一个粉色身影靠近了
lines.en: Another pink shape comes near

lines.zh: 我们一起笑，声音叠在一起
lines.en: We laugh and the sounds overlap
My feeler touches hers
We circle each other slowly

lines.zh: 她戳我的肚子，我缩了一下
lines.en: She pokes my belly and I flinch
I give her half the candy
Our steam mixes into one cloud
She laughs more than I do

lines.zh: 我把她举起来转了一圈
lines.en: I lift her up and spin once

lines.zh: 这一带以后有两只魔人了
lines.en: Two Majins share this land now

lines.zh: 我捏起来，像捏一颗豆子
lines.en: I pinch it up like a bean

lines.zh: 我把它塞进嘴里，又吐出来
lines.en: I put it in my mouth and spit it out
It flattens between my fingers
I hold it to my eye for a long while
It's hard, so it's not food
I roll it into a ball and bounce it
I break it in half to see inside

lines.zh: 我把它放在头顶，看它掉下来
lines.en: I set it on my head and watch it fall
This one I'll keep; it glows
I swallow it and I'm still hungry

lines.zh: 你举起武器，我的笑没了
lines.en: You raise a weapon and my smile drops

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，然后锁住你
lines.en: My head tilts, then locks onto you
You meant to hit me, didn't you
My arm stretches out long

lines.zh: 地面震了一下，我从上面压下
lines.en: The ground shakes; I come down from above
My fingertips begin to glow

lines.zh: 我知道你躲得很快，我看看多快
lines.en: I know you dodge well; let's see how well
The ki in my belly churns
I'm not angry; I'm serious
Then I'll turn you into candy

lines.zh: 粉色的一团气包住了我
lines.en: A pink aura wraps around me
You moved first; I remember
I'm smiling, but my eyes are on you
Let's play; this time for real

lines.zh: 我悬在你上方，不急不慢
lines.en: I hover above you, unhurried

lines.zh: 手指一点，小气弹飞过去
lines.en: One finger flick, and small ki blasts fly
You dodge one; more follow

lines.zh: 我的手臂拐了个弯追你
lines.en: My arm bends around to chase you
I watch you run, smiling

lines.zh: 气弹连成串，堵住你的路
lines.en: My ki blasts string together and block your path
That arm of mine comes swinging back

lines.zh: 我在找你先眨眼的瞬间
lines.en: I'm waiting for the instant you blink

lines.zh: 你每躲一次，我就更高兴
lines.en: Every dodge makes me happier
I herd you toward open ground

lines.zh: 你再躲，我就用口香糖了
lines.en: Dodge again and I'll use my gum
The air grows hot under my ki

lines.zh: 我慢慢飘近，故意让你看见
lines.en: I drift closer on purpose, letting you see

lines.zh: 魔人拳已经抬到你面前。
lines.en: My Majin fist is already at your face.
I predict your next move is left
If you stop, so do I
My smile hasn't changed at all
This whole area is locked down

lines.zh: 我的拳头到了你面前才停下
lines.en: My fist stops right at your face

lines.zh: 一记魔人拳打在你的胸口
lines.en: A Majin punch lands on your chest

lines.zh: 我的手臂拉长，从侧面抽过来
lines.en: My arm stretches and whips in from the side
I kick three times in midair
The blow knocks you back a stretch

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领往上提
lines.en: I grab your collar and lift
My belly shoves you off your feet

lines.zh: 这一下擦着你的头过去
lines.en: That one grazes past your head

lines.zh: 我的手指弹了你额头一下
lines.en: I flick your forehead with one finger
You block it, but your arm is shaking
I appear behind you

lines.zh: 气弹跟着拳头一起来了
lines.en: Ki blasts come with the punch
You hit the ground; I land after
I laugh once and add another punch

lines.zh: 这次没打中，我很不高兴
lines.en: That missed, and I'm not pleased

lines.zh: 我退开一点，看你还站不站得住
lines.en: I pull back to see if you can still stand

lines.zh: 空气里先浮出一团粉色
lines.en: A pink shape surfaces in the air first
I step out of the steam

lines.zh: 一个圆滚滚的身影落在你面前
lines.en: A round shape drops in front of you

lines.zh: 我的触须先冒出来，然后才是脸
lines.en: My feeler appears, then my face

lines.zh: 地面凹了一块，我才站稳
lines.en: The ground dips before I settle
I laugh, softly

lines.zh: 四周的温度升高了一点
lines.en: The air around us warms a little

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方就看见你了
lines.en: I saw you from very far away
My ki pushes the dust away
I raise a hand, as if greeting you
Is someone here? I've arrived

lines.zh: 我一落地，蒸汽就喷出来
lines.en: I land and steam bursts out

lines.zh: 我的身体鼓了一下，又收回
lines.en: My body swells once and settles
I tilt my head to measure your height
I smell something fun
A quiet place; I like it

lines.zh: 我的影子很圆，盖住一大片
lines.en: My round shadow covers a wide patch
What shall we play today

lines.zh: 火烫到我，我讨厌烫的东西
lines.en: Fire burns me and I hate hot things
I fall and my belly lands first
Water fills me up; I feel so heavy
The blast blows a chunk off me
An arrow sticks in me like a thorn

lines.zh: 魔法缠住我，我笑不出来
lines.en: Magic tangles me and I can't laugh

lines.zh: 好久没吃糖了，我更饿了
lines.en: No candy in so long; I'm hungrier
Lightning strikes and I smoke all over

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我掉得很慢
lines.en: Nothing below; I fall slowly
